_meta_itemized.notes: Kent Jones, County Clerk, 2014 Post-Election; split50 form, TYPED ledgers on a scanned sheet (the handwriting-heavy 2014 cycle, but this filer typed). Contributions and expenditures are the SAME figure ($6,351.27) and the balance is $0.00 - the filer raised and spent exactly the same amount, which is what the cover states. SOURCE PROPERTIES: (1) The p2 'Mailing Address' column does not hold addresses - the filer typed a PURPOSE there ('donation', 'campaign donation'). No street or PO box appears on either real row, so donor_city / donor_state are honestly BLANK because the filer LEFT THE ADDRESS EMPTY (not a county redaction - the 2014 sheets are unredacted; the only address on the page is the printed specimen's). (2) $5,979.77 of the $6,351.27 raised is the candidate's OWN contribution to his campaign, itemized as a donor row in his own name - retained verbatim as the form records it. (3) On p3 a HANDWRITTEN '$6351.27' is written into the Amount column two ruled rows BELOW the last transaction (bands 22-23) - it is a hand-tallied grand total, matching the printed box, and is NOT transcribed as a transaction. (4) The p3 row dated '9/14/14/' carries a stray trailing slash; the date is otherwise unambiguous and is kept (gate 8's well-formed-typo case), with the verbatim in the row note. (5) The p3 filer typo 'dorr hanger printing' is retained verbatim. GEOMETRY: p3 is MEASURED - the page's printed rules give a clean regular grid and the 14 rows occupy detected bands 7-20 (verified by render-back: band 7 resolves to '3/9/14 S/C Clerk / filing fee / $537.36'). p2 is DECLARED because the filled rows' ink merges and splits the top bands (the detector returns 50 bands, the first 20 of them header text lines); the frame is a least-squares FIT to the page's own 30 clean lower rules - pitch 1.96947, max residual 0.069% of page height, mean 0.023% - extrapolated up five bands to the header at y=22.147, and validated by render-back: declared band 5 resolves exactly to '8/27/14 Kent Jones / campaign donation / $5,979.77'.
